institution: The University of Texas at Austin
plan: Plan of Study, 2026-2028 Undergraduate Catalog (Computer Science Option)
subject: C S
title: Introduction to Programming
description: First part of a two-part sequence in programming. Fundamental concepts of structured programming; procedures and data structures with a focus on problem solving strategies and implementation; introduction to concepts of informal specification, informal reasoning about program behavior, debugging, and ad hoc testing.

institution: The University of Texas at Austin
plan: Plan of Study, 2026-2028 Undergraduate Catalog (Computer Science Option)
subject: M
title: M 408C or M 408N (Differential and Integral Calculus)
notes: Student chooses one: Differential and Integral Calculus | Differential Calculus for Science.
description: A first calculus course: limits, derivatives and their applications, and an introduction to integrals. Some universities offer it as one accelerated course and others split the same material over a longer sequence.

institution: The University of Texas at Austin
plan: Plan of Study, 2026-2028 Undergraduate Catalog (Computer Science Option)
title: U.S. History (060)
description: A general education course in United States history, often a survey of the nation's political, social, and economic development. Many public universities in the U.S. require such courses by state law.

institution: The University of Texas at Austin
plan: Plan of Study, 2026-2028 Undergraduate Catalog (Computer Science Option)
title: Social and Behavioral Sciences (080)
description: A general education course on how individuals, groups, and societies behave, from a field such as psychology, sociology, economics, or anthropology. These courses introduce the field's research methods and main theories.

institution: The University of Texas at Austin
plan: Plan of Study, 2026-2028 Undergraduate Catalog (Computer Science Option)
title: First-Year Signature Course (090)
description: A small first-year seminar on a topic chosen by the instructor, emphasizing discussion, writing, and university-level inquiry. These courses also introduce students to the university's resources.

institution: The University of Texas at Austin
plan: Plan of Study, 2026-2028 Undergraduate Catalog (Computer Science Option)
subject: C S
title: Discrete Mathematics for Computer Science
description: A focus on discrete mathematical tools of fundamental importance to the working computer scientist. An emphasis is placed on using logical notation to express rigorous mathematical arguments. Subjects include proof by induction, introduction to graph theory, recurrences, sets, functions, and an introduction to program correctness.

institution: The University of Texas at Austin
plan: Plan of Study, 2026-2028 Undergraduate Catalog (Computer Science Option)
subject: C S
title: Data Structures
description: Second part of a two-part sequence in programming. Introduction to specifications, simple unit testing, and debugging; building and using canonical data structures; algorithm analysis and reasoning techniques such as assertions and invariants.

institution: The University of Texas at Austin
plan: Plan of Study, 2026-2028 Undergraduate Catalog (Computer Science Option)
subject: M
title: M 408D or M 408S (Sequences, Series, and Multivariable Calculus)
notes: Student chooses one: Sequences, Series, and Multivariable Calculus | Integral Calculus for Science.
description: A second calculus course: techniques and applications of integration and, in accelerated versions, sequences, series, and an introduction to multivariable calculus.

plan: Plan of Study, 2026-2028 Undergraduate Catalog (Computer Science Option)
subject: RHE
title: Rhetoric and Writing
description: An introductory writing course that includes instruction in practical reasoning and the principles of rhetoric.

institution: The University of Texas at Austin
plan: Plan of Study, 2026-2028 Undergraduate Catalog (Computer Science Option)
subject: C S
title: Computer Organization and Architecture
description: An introduction to low-level computer design ranging from the basics of digital design to the hardware/software interface for application programs. Includes basic systems principles of pipelining and caching, and requires writing and understanding programs at multiple levels.

institution: The University of Texas at Austin
plan: Plan of Study, 2026-2028 Undergraduate Catalog (Computer Science Option)
title: SDS 321 or M 362K (Introduction to Probability and Statistics)
notes: Student chooses one: Introduction to Probability and Statistics | Probability I.
description: A calculus-based introduction to probability: random variables, common distributions, expectation, and limit theorems, sometimes with an introduction to statistical inference.

institution: The University of Texas at Austin
plan: Plan of Study, 2026-2028 Undergraduate Catalog (Computer Science Option)
subject: GOV
title: American and Texas Government
description: A basic survey of American government, including fundamental political institutions, federal, state, and local; special attention to the United States and Texas Constitutions.

institution: The University of Texas at Austin
plan: Plan of Study, 2026-2028 Undergraduate Catalog (Computer Science Option)
title: Visual and Performing Arts (050)
description: A general education course in the arts, such as art history, music, theatre, dance, or film. These courses build an understanding of artistic works and how they are made.

institution: The University of Texas at Austin
plan: Plan of Study, 2026-2028 Undergraduate Catalog (Computer Science Option)
subject: C S
title: Ethical Foundations of Computer Science
description: An introduction to reasoning about the effects of the technology created by computer scientists and understanding the ethical and real-world consequences of that technology. Emphasizes direct participation and discussion using case studies to illustrate ethical topics.

institution: The University of Texas at Austin
plan: Plan of Study, 2026-2028 Undergraduate Catalog (Computer Science Option)
subject: C S
title: Principles of Computer Systems
description: An introduction to computer systems software abstractions with an emphasis on the connection of these abstractions to underlying computer hardware. Key abstractions include threads, virtual memory, protection, and I/O. Requires writing of synchronized multithreaded programs and pieces of an operating system.

description: An upper-level computer science course chosen by the student from the department's offerings, such as operating systems, networks, databases, artificial intelligence, security, or graphics.

institution: The University of Texas at Austin
plan: Plan of Study, 2026-2028 Undergraduate Catalog (Computer Science Option)
subject: M
title: Matrices and Matrix Calculations
description: Techniques of matrix calculations and applications of linear algebra.

subject: GOV
title: Issues and Policies in American Government
description: Analysis of underlying themes concerned with American political institutions and policies, including the United States Constitution.
